# Generate Documentation

Create concise documentation that reflects the code and the current product scope.

Ask for the intended audience or target document if that is not clear.

## Requirements

- Verify commands, routes, data formats, assumptions, and deployment behavior against source files and workflows.
- Follow the existing README tone and Markdown conventions; use relative links that resolve.
- Document user-facing calculation assumptions and unit behavior accurately.
- Do not invent functionality, promise future features, or expose user data or secrets.
- Update only the documentation needed for the request and check any relevant links or command names.
